text.p: Microelectronic Packaging Inc said it started a restructuring that will involve job cuts at its facilities in San Diego and Sinapore and which it expects will save about $4.5 million a year.
It said the restructuring is also designed to allow the company to focus on its core businesses.

"Our strategy is to maximize cash flow from our pressed ceramics business, continue the growth and profitability of our multichip line and complete the final phase of our multilayer chip operations in Sinagpore," President and Chief Executive Officer Alfred Moran said in a statement.
Microelectronic Packaging makes semiconductor packaging for integrated circuit and electronic systems manufacturers.
